terra.problem: Saying the whole north showed up goes beyond the kings and armies the passage describes.
The passage does not say that nobody brought treasure.
“Wrong valley” uses “wrong” for the baker’s answer.
The passage does not say Joshua attacked without delay. The stated time concerns when the LORD would deliver the enemies.
Burning the chariots does not establish that nothing remained to leave behind.
“Line for line” suggests the wording matches exactly, but verses 6 and 9 use different wording.
The oven joke does not make clear what “over way less” means, so the comparison does not click.
Comparing the war to a weekend job makes light of the fighting.
The text says Anakim survived in three cities, not that only three cities were left on the map.
“Wrong half of the list” uses “wrong” for the baker’s answer.
The closing joke is about the answer list rather than the passage.
The passage says the land was allotted to Israel’s tribes, but does not say every tribe received its own share.
